summary: JBIC, a Japanese government-affiliated policy bank, filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for guaranteed bonds, unconditionally and irrevocably guaranteed as to principal and interest by Japan, under its 2021 SEC shelf. Coupon, maturity, denomination and pricing are left blank in this subject-to-completion draft. Bonds are registered form, minimum 100,000 with 1,000 increments, cleared through Euroclear/Clearstream via a common safekeeper, with application for Luxembourg Stock Exchange official listing and Euro MTF trading. Tax-redemption at par in whole only. This is routine sovereign-guaranteed debt issuance, not a special situation; watch final coupon, size and spread to JGBs.
